Simulate entomological hut trial data from the basic model

simulate_eht_data.Rd

Simulates hut trial outcomes (UA, UD, FA, FD) for a control arm and one or more treatment arms from the basic model, with known parameter values. Parameters use the same names as the Stan output, so the values used here can be compared directly with extract_stan_summary. Only the basic model (model_type = "basic") is supported: the data have no time or day structure and cannot be used for the semifield model.

Usage

simulate_eht_data(
  n_obs = 100,
  n_mosquitoes = 10,
  alpha_0 = 0.15,
  mu_0 = 0.14,
  pC_0 = 0.92,
  treatments = data.frame(vector_control_product = "NewITN", HostAvailabilityReduction =
    0.69, KillingDuringHostSeeking = 3.8, PostprandialKilling = 0.52),
  control_name = "Control",
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

n_obs

Integer. Number of observations (hut-nights) per arm.

n_mosquitoes

Integer. Number of mosquitoes per observation.

alpha_0

Numeric. Baseline attack rate (> 0).

mu_0

Numeric. Baseline mortality rate (> 0).

pC_0

Numeric. Baseline probability of surviving after blood-feeding (between 0 and 1).

treatments

Data frame with one row per treatment arm and columns:

  • vector_control_product: Name of the product

  • HostAvailabilityReduction: Reduction in host availability (between 0 and 1)

  • KillingDuringHostSeeking: Additional mortality during host seeking, as a multiple of alpha_0 (>= 0)

  • PostprandialKilling: Post-prandial killing (between 0 and 1)

control_name

Character. Product name of the control arm.

seed

Integer or NULL. If given, passed to set.seed() before simulating (this sets the global random seed).

Value

A tibble with one row per observation and columns UA, UD, FA, FD, treatment (0 = control, 1, 2, ... in the order of treatments) and vector_control_product. Pass it to format_eht_data to add the derived columns.

Details

For a treatment arm, the rates are modified as in the basic Stan model:

  • attack rate: (1 - HostAvailabilityReduction) * alpha_0

  • mortality rate: mu_0 + KillingDuringHostSeeking * alpha_0

  • survival after feeding: pC_0 * (1 - PostprandialKilling)

The control arm uses alpha_0, mu_0 and pC_0. Each observation is a multinomial draw of n_mosquitoes over the four outcome probabilities.

Examples

# One treatment arm
sim <- simulate_eht_data(seed = 42)
head(sim)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>      UA    UD    FA    FD treatment vector_control_product
#>   <int> <int> <int> <int>     <int> <chr>                 
#> 1     6     3     1     0         0 Control               
#> 2     6     2     2     0         0 Control               
#> 3     7     0     3     0         0 Control               
#> 4     7     1     2     0         0 Control               
#> 5     5     2     3     0         0 Control               
#> 6     5     5     0     0         0 Control               

# Two treatment arms
sim <- simulate_eht_data(
  treatments = data.frame(
    vector_control_product = c("Standard_ITN", "New_ITN"),
    HostAvailabilityReduction = c(0.4, 0.69),
    KillingDuringHostSeeking = c(1.5, 3.8),
    PostprandialKilling = c(0.3, 0.52)
  ),
  seed = 42
)
eht_data <- format_eht_data(sim)
